sitrep: Cmdr. Varen Keth of Hegemony Flight Induction issues this assignment. Your carrier is Manticore, a Dragon-class ship. Conduct training in the Garden sector of Isham. Training - Practice spaceborne fighter operations.

event.eventMessage: Alpha sweep point reached. Press T to cycle Alpha drones. Track and destroy all four.
Bravo drones in range. Press T to cycle Bravo drones. Track and destroy all four.
Alpha drones destroyed. Re-engage Autonav and proceed to waypoint 3 for Bravo.
All drones destroyed. Proceed to waypoint 4 for the Vampires.
Vampires destroyed. Re-engage Autonav and return to Manticore.
